component.name: Freequence
component.summary: Modern self-hosted music player and streaming desktop client

description.p: Freequence is a modern self-hosted music streaming player and desktop client built in Rust. It scans your local music library, extracts rich metadata and high-resolution album artwork, and provides a fluid, keyboard-reachable interface with dark mode and seek support.

ul.li: High-performance audio scanning for MP3, FLAC, OGG, Opus, M4A, and WAV files
Embedded SQLite database maintaining play counts, favorites, and playlists
Built-in Subsonic / OpenSubsonic API compatibility for mobile apps (Symfonium, DSub, Amperfy)
Low memory footprint and fast native desktop performance

description.p: Initial release of Freequence Linux desktop app built with Rust and Tauri v2.
